location: Manuscript_EN line 449 (Supp Fig 21) — "5'UTR/near-TSS (500-2,000 bp upstream)" and "Intergenic (>2,000 bp from any annotated feature)"
issue: Both region definitions in the legend are wrong; neither 500-2,000 bp nor 2,000 bp appears anywhere in the producing code. The legend also mislabels the 1,078 set as 'AAGCCCG 6mA'.
evidence: 62_/scripts/stratified_position_enrichment.py:181-242 (classify_sites_vectorized, the function main() calls at line 486) defines, in this precedence order: (1) inside a gene body (first gene ordered by gene_start whose start<=pos<=end) -> '5UTR_approx' if 0 <= signed TSS distance <= 100, 'intergenic' if distance < 0, else 'CDS_internal'; (2) not in any gene body -> 'promoter' if the nearest TSS has -500 <= distance <= -1 (i.e. 1-500 bp upstream); (3) otherwise 'intergenic'. Distances are strand-signed; TSS from 18_tss_analyses/comprehensive_tss_table.csv. The 1,078 set is AAGCCCG-CONTEXT pooled: 674 4mC + 404 6mA (recomputed).
proposed_fix: Legend should read: 5'UTR = TSS to +100 bp within the gene body; promoter = 1-500 bp upstream of the nearest TSS and outside every gene body; CDS = within a gene body >100 bp downstream of its TSS; intergenic = all remaining sites (outside gene bodies and >500 bp upstream of every TSS, plus in-body sites upstream of that gene's TSS). Label the bars 'AAGCCCG-context (4mC+6mA)'.

issue: The GCCGGC-context split currently in both the body and the Supp Fig 9 legend does not reproduce. The set the figures draw contains 1,313 4mC and 346 6mA rows.
